header.name: Ergonomics / Human Factors for Design
header.description: In designing Ergonomics takes care of the Users' need, their limitations and abilities. Various aspects of basic anthropometry, physical, physiological, psychological and biomechanical limitations and abilities of the human body with reference to human centred design of products and systems will be explained. Students will learn the principles, overview and background of ergonomics. Develop the skill to identify the user friendly man machine environment system. Know the methods and processes to evaluate the products, facilities, environment, jobs and tasks. This course will enlighten the students about all aspects of design of systems, services and facilities created and used by man. It will help in finding real time solutions to improve the quality of life and performance of an individual.
prerequisites_desirable: Basic knowledge of different methods of measurement
prerequisites_desirable_resolved: Basic knowledge of different methods of measurement

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to introduced to the basics of ergonomics/human factors,evolution and development of this discipline and its progress till date.They will able to correlate the principles of ergonomics in design requirement.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students will comprehend various aspects of physical, biomechanical, organisational, environmental, cognitive and office ergonomics. They will be acquinted with the methods of collecting some parametric data and will develop the skills to interprete and use it accordingly.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to assess the usefulness of knowledge and skills related to ergonomics in the design process.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to apply the knowledge of ergonomics, methods and processes to design and evaluate products, systems, services, facilities, environment, jobs and tasks for user centered design
